In February, I visited your practice and was seen twice by another doctor. Unfortunately, my condition did not improve, and there was no follow-up.

I consider myself very fortunate that Dr. Badhe later saw me. She listened carefully, arranged appropriate tests, and told me that if my symptoms persisted, she would write a referral letter to the hospital. When things didn’t improve, she did exactly that.

Although the hospital initially rejected the referral, Dr. Badhe personally called me twice, showing great concern for my health, and advised me to go to A&E immediately. I followed her advice and was admitted to the hospital overnight. At first, the doctors suspected I had suffered a stroke, but it was later determined that the cause was spinal canal narrowing.

I am truly grateful for Dr. Badhe’s professionalism, compassion, and decisive action. I believe her efforts played a key role in identifying the real cause of my condition and preventing further complications.

I would also like to thank Dr. Eghbal, who has always been kind and supportive.

Please kindly pass on my appreciation to both Dr. Badhe and Dr. Eghbal.

Warm regards,
